scope: Missing loop constructor controls for frozen builtin-identity, not toolchain adoption or a new UnitDerivative obligation.
notes: Each command is the actual shell command passed to exec_command in its recorded workdir. Environment assignments are explicit in command; PATH appends the host PATH after pinned tools.
Terminal output is retained inline; redirected logs are separately byte-bound. Tool chunk IDs identify observations, not timing or duration.

Aeneas predecessor was initially expected to emit successfully; it instead rejected source-name registration. That actual unexpected exit is retained as a characterized diagnostic, not hidden or relabelled as a passing test.

All generated Lean modules were compiled from their current recorded .lean files to .olean by the retained commands. Imported existing Aeneas library artifacts are trusted, not rebuilt by this supplement.
Original wrong-answer witness means clean candidate translation, not predecessor translation. Initial malformed theorem attempts are marked development history and contribute no negative evidence.
